basic_details.short_information: The University of Kashmir has invited online applications for Associate Professor posts in various departments, institutes and centres of its Main Campus under Brief Advertisement Notice No. 19 of 2026. Online forms and hard copies can be submitted from 17 November 2026. The last date for online forms is 16 December 2026 and for the hard copy 23 December 2026. The detailed advertisement notice will be on www.kashmiruniversity.net under the Jobs/Recruitment link from 17 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are invited online. The notice gives these dates for submission:

The detailed Advertisement Notice(s) with essential qualifications, reservation of posts and other terms and conditions will be on www.kashmiruniversity.net under the Jobs/Recruitment link from 17 November 2026. The brief notice does not name the address for the hard copy or the application link.

content_sections.heading: About University of Kashmir
content_sections.text: The University of Kashmir is based at University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006. Its letterhead describes it as NAAC Accredited Grade "A++". This notice is issued by the Deputy Registrar (Recruitment).

content_sections.heading: Departments Covered
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following departments, institutes and centres of the Main Campus. It prints no post count against any of them. Arabic Bio-Chemistry Bio-Technology Botany Centre of Central Asian Studies Chemistry Computer Science Centre for Distance & Online Education Economics Education Electronics & Instrumentation Technology English Geography & Disaster Management Hindi History Institute of Home Science Iqbal Institute of Culture & Philosophy Shah-i-Hamdan Institute of Islamic Studies Kashmiri Law Library & Information Science Linguistics Management Studies Mathematics Persian Pharmaceutical Science Political Science Centre of Research for Development Shaikh-Ul-Aalam Centre for Multidisciplinary Studies Sociology Statistics Tourism, Hospitality and Leisure Studies Urdu & Zoology

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for University of Kashmir Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online forms is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. When do applications start?
faq.answer: Submission of online forms and hard copy starts on 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for the hard copy?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the hard copy is 23 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which departments have Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The posts are in various departments, institutes and centres of the Main Campus, such as Arabic, Botany, Computer Science, Law, Management Studies and Zoology. The full list is in this article.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the qualifications and terms be published?
faq.answer: The detailed Advertisement Notice with essential qualifications, reservation of posts and other terms and conditions will be on www.kashmiruniversity.net under the Jobs/Recruitment link from 17 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. Are the posts final?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the availability of posts is tentative and subject to addition, alteration or deletion, to be shown in the detailed final Advertisement Notice.

faq.question: Q7. Is the application online or offline?
faq.answer: Online applications are invited, and a hard copy must also be submitted by 23 December 2026.
